text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who carves her name into 
history as the "strongest." As her 
Trainer, I leave her hoofprints etched 
right here—

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Her name is—Duramente. Born into a lineage 
of world-class athletes, she is the 
"crystallization of bloodlines" inheriting 
their talent.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
At her Twinkle Series debut press 
conference, she declared her goal of 
becoming the "strongest," and boldly 
announced her intent to win the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
However, she still had an immature side. 
When the crowd began cheering in high 
expectation after her declaration, she 
started trembling with nerves.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Supporting her through it all was my job— 
Having safely regained her composure, she 
declared that she would first set her 
sights on the Classic Triple Crown.
